title: Resolve local manifest paths
why: A missing local package, workspace member, executable, target, or script entry point makes the checked-out project incomplete or unbuildable.
suggestion: Add the referenced file or package, or correct the manifest path.
limitations: Cargo literal workspace members, path dependencies, and explicit target paths are checked.

package.json literal workspace members and bin entries are checked; wildcard workspaces are not. Executables under conventional build-output directories are accepted when the output is named by a build hook or package files list and a build hook exists.
PEP 621 project.scripts module paths are checked in the project root and src layout, or the most-specific matching setuptools package-dir mapping when declared.
